items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 108:1
items.html: From the Chazeh downward is called the externality of the Partzuf, and it divides into two discernments: front and back. The two lower thirds of Tifferet are called the externality from the side of the front, and the NHYM are called the externality from the side of the back. And these two discernments fell to the empty void beneath the conclusion of the feet of AK, at the time of the second restriction, when the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Chazeh [chest] of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG of AK, before the coupling Malchut ascended to the discernment of the coupling in the openings of the eyes; and then they fell to the discernment of the empty void at the point of this world, and these two discernments were considered like the empty void beneath the conclusion of the feet of AK. (Item 3).
